caption: Castello and old town, Gallipoli
composition: Fortified island town linked by arched bridge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the sea at mid-morning, looking at Gallipoli's fortified island town across calm water. The massive round bastion of the Castello anchors the right of the frame, the arched stone bridge running toward it, while the town walls and pale houses stretch leftward along the shoreline. The modelled 23 September 2026, 08:06 sky is clear and blue, and the whole fortified silhouette mirrors softly in the glassy water.
